system.description:
Range: 5 spaces

White foxes are cunning survivors that use all their tricks to deceive their enemies. You harness this power, speaking nothing but lies.

Choose a creature within 5 spaces. and make a 4:1 Soul (Metaphysics) check. The target must make an opposed Willpower check or become unable to speak anything but lies until the start of your next turn.

While affected, the target gains a bonus to their Training in Deception equal to your Training in Metaphysics. They may choose to voluntarily fail the Willpower check to gain this benefit.

Additionally, creatures by this ability are immune to any effects that would force them to speak the truth.

You may spend 1 Resolve at the start of your turn to sustain this effect.

Effect: @UUID[Compendium.titan-vttrpg-compendium.effects.ActiveEffect.7oLlzQzlBjGTr6Cp]{Fox's Cunning}
